ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white fields occupy the central regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edges and distal tips. The right lobe (visual right) features a high-density cluster of dark linear and geometric streaks, while the area surrounding the median notch is dominated by a solid low-intensity black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 75-80 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are present along the entire trailing edge boundary; distal tips exhibit significantly higher amplitude, jagged 'saw-tooth' peak-to-valley variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a slight concave sweep originating from the notch and extending toward the distal tips; the lower visible boundaries show a broad convex curve toward the waterline.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-contrast white marks (diameter approx. 5-12 pixels) are detected within the dark pigmentation zone near the central notch and lower right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, low-intensity linear rake marks are visible; specifically, a cluster of four parallel diagonal lines and intersecting vertical lines on the right lobe, and two shorter horizontal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring on the right lobe; white, high-intensity pixel clusters consistent with calcified barnacle colonization are localized at the terminal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique cross-hatched intersection of three distinct linear scars on the upper-mid section of the right lobe forming a geometric grid pattern.
